description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-19 under road-to-a-canvas-the-code-owns step 7.3, which added the baseline-update sentence to this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover writing a spec, a visual-regression screenshot test, updating baselines, a Page Object for a checkout form, and a German variant. Near-misses are the three neighbours whose vocabulary overlaps — suite architecture (playwright-architect), mobile E2E framework choice (mobile-e2e-strategy), HTTP endpoint tests without a browser (api-testing). Counterexamples guard the 'screenshot' and 'test' homonyms outside browser automation.

queries.q: write a playwright test that logs in and checks the dashboard heading
add a visual regression test for the pricing page with toHaveScreenshot
the button restyle broke three snapshot baselines, how do I update them properly?
create a Page Object for the checkout form and use it in an E2E spec
Schreib mir einen Playwright-Test, der das Kontaktformular ausfüllt und die Erfolgsmeldung prüft
design our E2E suite: how should we split fixtures and what runs in CI versus locally?
queries.note: suite architecture and the CI-vs-local split → playwright-architect

queries.q: should we use Detox or Maestro for end-to-end tests of our React Native app?
write integration tests for the POST /orders endpoint, asserting the JSON response
queries.note: an HTTP endpoint test with no browser → api-testing

queries.q: take a screenshot of my terminal output and attach it to the bug report
queries.note: 'screenshot' as a manual capture, not a visual assertion

queries.q: add a unit test for the price rounding helper in the cart module
queries.note: a unit test of a pure function, no browser automation
